sources.note: Reviewed the repository's own pack status and test checklist; this is not an in-game test.

records.claim: The FPS Booster and Lithium conclusions are based on static inspection of the supplied archives; no in-game FPS test was performed.

sources.note: Repository analysis of the two user-supplied pack archives; source URL is an audit trail for the analysis, not proof of performance gains.

limitations: Findings describe archive contents and do not establish that the packs improve performance.
